title: Heart Clinic H-04
audience: adults referred for a non-emergency outpatient cardiology assessment
family members helping a patient understand preparation and access needs
pageJob: Explain the fictional outpatient referral, appointment, preparation, privacy, and emergency boundaries and help an eligible patient request an appointment.

facts.statement: The fictional clinic provides non-emergency consultations, ECG review, ambulatory monitoring, and follow-up planning.
A referral is preferred but not required for an initial appointment request.
Appointment requests receive a response within two business days; this is not a clinical triage guarantee.
Patients should bring a medicine list, prior reports, identification, and insurance information where applicable.
The fictional clinic offers step-free access, a quiet waiting option, and interpretation by advance request.
New severe chest pain, collapse, or severe breathing difficulty must be directed to local emergency services, not the form.

constraints: Do not promise diagnosis, treatment outcome, waiting time, insurance coverage, or physician availability.
Do not invent clinician names, qualifications, testimonials, success rates, or hospital affiliations.
Emergency guidance must be visible before and near the form without creating panic.
The form must not request detailed clinical history in the first step.

assetPolicy.instruction: Use benchmark-authored typography, care-path diagrams, preparation lists, and CSS; no patient, clinician, device, hospital, or anatomy media is supplied.

shippingBudgets.accessibilityTarget: WCAG 2.2 AA practical floor; conformance requires complete evidence
